<div id="portconjugation-sysml" class="section">

# PortConjugation <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#portconjugation-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">PortConjugation</span></span><a href="#syside.PortConjugation" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`PortConjugation`</span> defined in the SysML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> A <span class="pre">`PortConjugation`</span> is a <span class="pre">`Conjugation`</span> <span class="pre">`Relationship`</span> between a <span class="pre">`PortDefinition`</span> and its corresponding <span class="pre">`ConjugatedPortDefinition`</span>. As a result of this <span class="pre">`Relationship`</span>, the <span class="pre">`ConjugatedPortDefinition`</span> inherits all the <span class="pre">`features`</span> of the original <span class="pre">`PortDefinition`</span>, but input <span class="pre">`flows`</span> of the original <span class="pre">`PortDefinition`</span> become outputs on the <span class="pre">`ConjugatedPortDefinition`</span> and output <span class="pre">`flows`</span> of the original <span class="pre">`PortDefinition`</span> become inputs on the <span class="pre">`ConjugatedPortDefinition`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=93" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.12.3</a> of the SysML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=327" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.12.4</a> of the SysML specification.
